The present petition filed under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks quashing of the FIR No. 39/2021,
under Sections 498A/406 of the IPC, registered at P.S. CAW Cell, Nanakpura and all other consequential proceedings emanating therefrom, including the chargesheet pending before the Court of Ms. Deepika Goel Shokeen, learned Metropolitan Magistrate, Mahila Court, Dwarka Court,
Delhi.

2. The marriage between petitioner no.1/husband and respondent no.2/wife was solemnized on 03.12.2011 as per Hindu rites and ceremonies.
3.
No child was born out of the said wedlock.

Subsequently, respondent no.2/complainant lodged an FIR against petitioner no.1 (husband), petitioner no. 2 (father-in-law) and petitioner no. 3 (brother- in-law).

5. On 16.06.2022, parties arrived at a settlement and as per the said settlement deed, petitioner no.1 has agreed to pay an amount of Rs. 2,85,00,000/- to the respondent no.2/wife towards full and final settlement of all her claims including istridhan, permanent alimony and maintenance - present, past and future.
The copy of the aforesaid settlement deed dated 16.06.2022 is on record (Annexure P-4).

6. In terms of the said settlement, the marriage between the parties stands dissolved by a decree of divorce dated 22.08.2022, passed by Ms. Madhu Jain, Principal Judge (South-East), Family Courts,
Saket, New Delhi (Annexure P-5).

Further, as per the settlement deed, an amount of Rs.
1,90,00,000/- has already been paid to respondent no.2 and the remaining amount of Rs.
95,00,000/- has been paid to her in court today, by means of a demand draft.

7. Petitioners and complainant/respondent no. 2 are present before the Court and have been duly identified by their respective counsel, as well as the Investigating Officer, S.I. Radha Sharma, P.S.
CWC/Nanak Pura.
8. A demand draft bearing no. 052607 dated 10.05.2023 for Rs. 95,00,000/- drawn on HDFC Bank has been handed over complainant/Respondent No.2, who acknowledges the receipt of the same.
9. The complainant/respondent No.2 states that the matter has been settled with the petitioners and she has no objection if the FIR is quashed.

Deepika Goel Shokeen, learned Metropolitan Magistrate, Mahila Court, Dwarka Court, Delhi.

13. In the interest of justice, the petition is allowed, and the FIR No. 39/2021, under Sections 498A/406 of the IPC, registered at P.S. CAW Cell, Nanakpura and all other consequential proceedings emanating therefrom, including the chargesheet pending before the Court of Ms.
Deepika Goel Shokeen, learned Metropolitan Magistrate, Mahila Court, Dwarka Court, Delhi, is hereby quashed.
